issue.title: Clear the stale design and artifact references sase bead doctor reports
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-ez.5 during epic sase-ez (plans:202608/revert_bead_reprefix_epic.md) and re-verified by sase-ez.land on 2026-08-03 at HEAD 943ffd0d3.

'sase bead doctor' for the sase project reports a persistent backlog of stale references that predates and is unrelated to that epic:

- WARNING: missing or malformed bead design references (14): sase-1p, sase-1s, sase-1t, sase-26, sase-4z, sase-54, sase-8n, sase-8o, sase-8p, sase-8q, sase-8r, sase-8s, sase-g, sase-n. These point at absolute paths under a since-removed /home/bryan/projects/github/sase-org/sase checkout, at ~/.sase/plans files that no longer exist, at bare 'plan.md', and at pytest tmpdir paths captured from a test run (for example sase-8q -> .../sase_22/.sase-check-tmp.*/pytest-of-bryan/...).
- WARNING: bead design reference owner mismatches (14): every phase sase-5l.1 through sase-5l.14 points at sdd/plans/202607/sase_doctor_diagnostics.md, whose frontmatter names the parent sase-5l rather than each phase.
- WARNING: unresolvable artifact references (1): sase-c6 -> bead:sase-bl.
- NOTE: 452 redundant close events across 314 beads.

Impact: doctor can never report clean for the sase project, so real regressions are hidden in the noise. sase-ez.5 had to hand-audit these to prove the epic added none of them.

Scope: fix or clear each class. The pytest-tmpdir design refs look like beads created by tests against the live store and are probably better removed than repaired; decide that explicitly. For the sase-5l.* owner mismatches, decide whether a phase bead pointing at its epic plan should be accepted rather than warned. Confirm afterwards that 'sase bead doctor' is clean or that every remaining line is intentional.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05 at master 0e40decdc. Each of these was re-verified as STILL REPRODUCING and is being closed as a deliberate deprioritization, not as fixed: sase-ed ('sase doctor -C project.bead_pages' still reports the same 5 misattributed commit links across sase-b5 and sase-b7 pages); sase-er (src/sase/main/bead_fast_path.py:9 still imports close_mutation_commit_message and mutation_commit_message at module scope); sase-es (src/sase/main/parser.py:461 still pulls COMMAND_REGISTRARS_BY_NAME from parser_full_registrars); sase-ev (crates/sase_core/src/bead/cli.rs:172 handle_show is still the dormant parity renderer); sase-ey (src/sase/bead/cli_detail.py still prints raw closed_at and src/sase/agents/cli_sync.py:152 still hardcodes a UTC strftime label); sase-f7 ('sase agent index verify -j' still ok=false with corrupt_rows=4, and missing_rows has grown from 2 to 77); sase-f9 ('sase bead doctor' still reports the same 14 malformed design refs, 14 sase-5l.* owner mismatches, 1 unresolvable artifact ref, and now 453 redundant close events). The project owner capped the reviewable task backlog at five and these did not make the cut. All scope and evidence stays readable here, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them automatically.
